title: Protect HttpOnly refresh-token cookie flows with CSRF binding
scope: refresh token remains out of JavaScript-readable storage and is delivered through the HttpOnly repoguard_refresh_token cookie
auth responses now also issue a readable repoguard_csrf_token cookie with the same refresh-token lifetime
cookie-backed refresh and logout require a matching X-RepoGuard-CSRF header while legacy body refreshToken calls remain compatible
refresh failures and logout clear both auth cookies
frontend refresh and logout requests read the CSRF cookie and send the required header
frontend Nginx production config now emits baseline CSP and security response headers
Release Images now runs production dependency audit before building the frontend
remaining: consider adding short-lived operation confirmation tokens for the most sensitive admin actions
tighten CSP further after external API base-url deployment modes are finalized
